rca_of_issue: Iter 3 fix: The Japanese Lombre (ハスブレロ) misidentification was caused by (a) GPT-5.2 vision being weaker on CJK-printed card text, and (b) the model over-relying on artwork resemblance. Fix combines: (1) switching to Gemini 3 Pro which handles CJK far better; (2) prompt now demands the native-name-first read with explicit katakana→English lookup table and an art_description cross-check step; (3) a 0.55 confidence gate at the API layer prevents any low-confidence guess from ever surfacing a wrong card name/price to the user. Verified: blurry image now returns identified=false with reasoning instead of a wrong card.
